name: Rapid Reload grants 8%, 16% and 25% ranged haste (#891)
contract: Rapid Reload rank 1 705512 reads 'Increases your ranged haste by $s1%.' In the installed Spell.dbc it is a passive, family 21, with one effect: SPELL_AURA_MOD_RANGED_HASTE (140), BasePoints 7 (DieSides 1, so 8%). Ranks 707863 and 712479 carry the same shape with 16% and 25%. AuraEffect::HandleAuraModRangedHaste (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:5012) calls Unit::ApplyAttackTimePercentMod(RANGED_ATTACK), which divides the ranged attack time by 1 + pct/100 (Unit.cpp:14145), so the expected ratios 1/1.08 = 0.9259, 1/1.16 = 0.8621 and 1/1.25 = 0.8 come from the DBC amounts. No script or SQL names any of the three ids. The baseline is read after equipping a crossbow so the ranged swing time is a real weapon speed. Each rank is tested on its own character: measured on slot 3, learning rank 2 right after a learn and unlearn of rank 1 on the same character re-taught rank 1 (knows_spell 1, aura 1) and left rank 2's aura absent, while learning rank 2 or 3 directly gave the DBC amounts 16 and 25. That single-character sequence is a fixture artefact of the raw learn action, not one of the tooltip's claims (whether the CoA talent path shares it is not verified).
